title: Circuit Guard visual kit: annotated screenshots and micro-illustrations for throttles, reconnects, and retry affordances
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, re-usable visual kit for the Quickstart and onboarding guides that surfaces clear recovery paths when the API returns transient conditions: throttles (soft and hard), request timeouts, and automatic retry behavior. The kit should include: compact micro-illustrations (SVG) that describe state, annotated product screenshot overlays that point to affected controls (retry button, polling indicator, backoff timer), three copy variants (concise, explanatory, developer-focused), and an export-ready set of PNG/JPEG sizes for docs and slides. Visuals must match Redwood brand tokens and be built for easy localization and accessibility (text alternatives and high contrast).
acceptance_criteria: Micro-illustration set (6 variants) exported as optimized SVGs with clear layers for color/shape overrides
Annotated screenshot overlays for desktop and mobile showing: soft throttle banner, hard throttle modal, timeout toast, and retry CTA placement
Three microcopy variants per state: concise, explain-then-action, and developer trace example
All assets uploaded to Figma and the onboarding assets drive folder; naming follows asset naming convention: CG_<state>_<variant>_<size>
Accessibility checklist passed (contrast ratios, alt text, keyboard focusable overlay demos)
Design handoff notes and screenshot placement spec added to the onboarding PR template
PNG/JPEG exports at 1x/2x sizes added to docs/images and proofs validated in staging docs pages
design_decisions: Use a 'circuit' motif to visually communicate 'guarding' the request path rather than alarm-centric red error art
Soft throttle visuals use amber palette and subtle micro-animations to imply temporary backoff; hard throttle uses muted red with clear action affordance
Timeout state uses a progress arc + reconnect handshake illustration emphasizing that user action is optional (auto-retry) and visible
Retry CTA uses primary brand blue; secondary ghost style for 'dismiss' to avoid accidental dismissals during retry windows
Avoid heavy illustrations in-console; overlays must be compact and not occlude critical metrics in Console dashboards
assets_needed: SVG micro-illustrations: CG_throttle_soft.svg, CG_throttle_hard.svg, CG_timeout.svg, CG_retry_handshake.svg, CG_kv_cache_badge.svg, CG_backoff_timer.svg
Annotated screenshots: desktop_1366, desktop_1440, mobile_375, mobile_414 (with overlays as separate exportable layers)
Export sizes: PNG 800x450, PNG 1200x675, SVG exports for docs and slides

notes: Goal is to reduce first-run confusion during rate-limited or transient failure events by making recovery options discoverable and framed as expected behavior rather than hard failures. Keep visuals modular so that the same micro-illustrations can be reused across the Quickstart, API docs, and Release notes.
